bugs.error_message: fm2mmgrok10: stride-8 VB draws use 32B FLOAT3 IA; POSITION UInt garbage; SamplesPassed=0

bugs.error_message: unknown type name 'REX_WEAK_FUNC'; definition 'sub_XXXX' cannot also be an alias (100 errors in FM2/generated/**)
bugs.root_cause: FM2/generated was emitted by the pre-rebase codegen. Rebasing onto origin/development restructured the templates: init_h.inja became an 8-line include stub, the REX_MM_LOAD_*/REX_WEAK_FUNC macros moved to pch_h.inja, and the same-address sub_<addr> alias scheme was replaced by distinct weak thunks (alias is rejected on Darwin).
bugs.fix: Regenerate: cmake --build FM2/out/build/<preset> --target fm2_codegen. Never hand-patch FM2/generated -- it is build output.

bugs.root_cause: fm2_manifest.toml names 0x82369D90/0x82369E08, so codegen emits D3DResource_AddRef/D3DResource_Release. The old templates ALSO emitted a sub_<addr> alias for every function, which hand-written code referenced; development dropped those aliases.
bugs.fix: Reference hooked guest functions by their manifest name, not sub_<addr>. REX_IMPORT(__imp__D3DResource_AddRef, ...) and REX_HOOK(D3DResource_AddRef, ...).
